title: 2nm Process Node (TSMC N2)
summary: TSMC's N2 family, the first node to combine nanosheet transistors with volume production from 2025.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Leading-edge silicon node; volume production 2025 — TSMC N2, Samsung SF2. Achieved.

Early commercial products exist. Market is forming with limited but growing deployment. Our research database tracks 9 independent sources on this technology.

businessMeaning: N2 is the default choice for the next generation of flagship mobile and accelerator silicon, so the practical question is allocation and cost per wafer rather than availability.
investmentLens: The clearest exposure is TSMC and its equipment chain; fabless customers carry the design cost, and the node's margin depends on how quickly yield matures.
